note: The Framework release the portal shell is served against, and the effects catalogue its pages place backgrounds from. Pages load the Framework from jsDelivr's npm form at ui.version (the /gh/ form is retired); ui.commit is the release's core runtime commit, and the npm files must equal its distr/ byte for byte. Take the pair from contracts/releases/<pair>.lock.json in simai/ui, never from a branch head. effects.commit is a catalogue commit its Pages deployed; SF.Effects checks every effect file against the catalogue's SHA-256.
